title: SenseTime Releases 8B Light Cannon U1.5-Lite-Preview: Not Big in Parameters, But Drives Closed-Source Models Crazy
excerpt: SenseTime has brought its lightweight native unified multimodal model to the center of the open-source stage - SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview is an early preview v
content_html:
SenseTime has brought its lightweight native unified multimodal model to the center of the open-source stage - SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview is an early preview version, based on the native NEO-Unify architecture, which is naturally capable of understanding, reasoning, generating, and editing multiple modalities. The most impressive part is that it only uses 8B-MoT parameters but delivers generation and editing quality comparable to commercial closed-source models, effectively using a small but powerful gun to withstand the firepower of the large model arms race.

The upgrades in this preview version are quite substantial. The resolution has been increased to 4K, with more detailed visuals and fewer visual artifacts; the ability to render Chinese and English text and complex layout compositions has significantly improved, making tasks like posters and infographics much easier; the visual control is more precise, no longer causing confusion when dealing with long texts and multiple constraint conditions; native image editing is also more reliable, including style transfer guided by reference images, multi-reference image synthesis, local infographic editing, and text editing.

Compared to the first generation U1, it has taken a significant lead in several generation and editing benchmarks: Qwen-Image-Bench has risen from 47.14 to 55.20 (using PE), ImgEdit-Bench has increased from 3.90 to 4.37, GEdit-Bench-en has climbed from 7.47 to 8.17, and GEdit-Bench-zh has moved up from 7.42 to 8.05. From U1 to U1.5, SenseTime has turned this open-source journey into a footnote of continuous innovation at the foundation model level.

What's even more exciting is still to come: the production-level model for creators, U1Pro, will also be opened for public beta testing soon. This means that SenseTime has already scheduled both "lightweight preview" and "production-ready" ends on the timeline for the unified multimodal line - small models lower the threshold, while large models then meet serious creative demands.

Project address: https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1/blob/feat/u1.5_preview/docs/u1.5_preview.md

content_html_zh:
商汤科技将其轻量级原生统一多模态模型推向了开源舞台的中心——SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview是早期预览版本，基于原生NEO-Unify架构，天然具备多模态理解、推理、生成和编辑能力。 最令人印象深刻的是，它只使用8B-MoT参数，却能提供媲美商业闭源模型的生成和编辑质量，有效地利用小而强大的枪来承受大型模型军备竞赛的火力。

这个预览版的升级还是相当可观的。 分辨率提升至4K，视觉效果更细腻，视觉伪影更少；渲染中英文文本和复杂布局构图的能力显着提高，使海报和信息图表等任务变得更加容易；视觉控制更加精准，不再在处理长文本和多重约束条件时造成混乱；原生图像编辑也更加可靠，包括参考图像引导的风格转换、多参考图像合成、本地信息图编辑和文本编辑。

与第一代U1相比，它在多个生成和编辑基准测试中都取得了显着领先：Qwen-Image-Bench从47.14上升到55.20（使用PE），ImgEdit-Bench从3.90上升到4.37，GEdit-Bench-en从7.47上升到8.17，GEdit-Bench-zh从7.42上升到8.05。 从U1到U1.5，商汤科技将这次开源之旅变成了基础模型层面持续创新的注脚。

更令人兴奋的还在后头：面向创作者的量产级模型U1Pro也即将开放公测。 这意味着商汤科技已经在统一多式联运的时间线上安排了“轻量级预览”和“量产”两端——小车型降低门槛，大车型则满足严肃的创意需求。

项目地址：https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1/blob/feat/u1.5_preview/docs/u1.5_preview.md
